title: Chemical profiling and sustainable valorization of post-distillation residues of Vitex rotundifolia
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14600-14613
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09731B, Paper

Kieu Dang Minh Nhut, Dao Pham Duy Quang, Phung Van Trung, Tran Hoai Cuong, Pham Thi Nhat Trinh, Nguyen Thi Nhu Quynh, Cao Van Du, Le Tien Dung
Post-distillation residue of Vitex rotundifolia retains non-volatile bioactive metabolites. Ultrasound-assisted extraction and LC-MS/MS dereplication support screening bioactivity and process-level sustainability trade-off assessment.
